long_description.body:
This relaxed, mid-weight cotton and polyester blend fleece pullover features the Gibson logo on the left front and a Premium Instruments graphic on the center back.



80% Cotton, 20% recycled polyester
Relaxed fit. Order one size down if you want a fitted sweatshirt
Machine wash warm with like colors. Do not bleach. Do not tumble dry. Do not dry clean. Do not iron if printed. Line dry in shade
